card.text: A Cepheid in the Andromeda Galaxy, 761 kiloparsecs away, that swells and shrinks every 16.5 days.

introduction.text: The Hubble Space Telescope measured its brightness in three colors and its pulsation of 16.5 days. Its galaxy's distance, 761 kiloparsecs, was measured from Cepheids like it.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
